d:
When Sousuke Yamada stumbles upon a shocking video online, his life is shattered.

A woman who looks exactly like his wife is caught in an intimate act, filmed in their daughter’s elementary school classroom. Is it really her? Who is this other man? Just how will Sousuke uncover the culprit hiding among the PTA’s members?

A scandalous mystery where desire and deception collide.
